definitions.explanation: The care, raising, and nurturing of children, especially young children and infants.

examples.japanese: {育児|いくじ}は{大変|たいへん}な{仕事|しごと}だ。
{育児|いくじ}{休暇|きゅうか}を{取|と}った。
{育児|いくじ}と{仕事|しごと}を{両立|りょうりつ}させる。

notes:
USAGE: Refers specifically to raising young children. Often discussed in context of work-life balance in Japan.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{育児|いくじ}{休暇|きゅうか}/{休業|きゅうぎょう} (parental leave)
・{育児|いくじ}{ノイローゼ|のいろーぜ} (parenting stress/burnout)
・{育児|いくじ}{支援|しえん} (childcare support)
・{育児|いくじ}{書|しょ} (parenting book)

SOCIAL CONTEXT: Japan has been working to encourage paternity leave ({男性|だんせい}の{育児|いくじ}{休暇|きゅうか}) to promote shared parenting.

RELATED:
・{子育|こそだ}て (child-rearing, broader term)
・{保育|ほいく} (childcare services/daycare)
